# Mobile1X

> Mobile1X is a mobile and AI product engineering studio based in Indore, India, founded by Rahul Pahuja. It designs, builds and launches Android, iOS and web apps, AI products, MVPs and fintech platforms for clients worldwide, and ships its own apps including Notes and Dedup.

Engagements typically range from $5,000 to $100,000+; standalone web performance audits start at $500. Every project has a written scope and quote before work starts.

## Services

- [Mobile App Development](https://mobile1x.com/services/mobile-app-development/): Android and iOS apps, designed, engineered and launched end to end.
- [AI Development](https://mobile1x.com/services/ai-development/): AI applications, agents and integrations for mobile and web products.
- [MVP Development](https://mobile1x.com/services/mvp-development/): From idea to a launched MVP, with scope and price agreed first.
- [Fintech Engineering](https://mobile1x.com/services/fintech-development/): Payments, banking integrations and security-conscious architecture.

## Products and case studies

- [Notes](https://mobile1x.com/work/notes/): A private, local-first AI notes app for Android and iOS.
- [Dedup](https://mobile1x.com/work/dedup/): A duplicate file remover and storage cleaner for Android.
- [The A2Z Collection](https://mobile1x.com/work/a2z/): A full-featured e-commerce web app, from browse to checkout.
- [POS System](https://a2zpos.netlify.app): Point-of-sale software: fast billing, inventory and sales reporting.
- [B2B Pharma Platform](https://mobile1x.com/pharma/): Connects pharmaceutical suppliers and buyers: catalogue, pricing, ordering.

## Guides

- [How Much Does It Cost to Build a Mobile App?](https://mobile1x.com/blog/how-much-does-it-cost-to-build-a-mobile-app/): What drives mobile app development cost, what a fair quote includes, and how to cut scope without hurting the product.
- [Native vs Flutter vs React Native: How to Choose](https://mobile1x.com/blog/native-vs-flutter-vs-react-native/): A practical guide to choosing between native Android/iOS, Flutter and React Native for your product.
